purpose: Implement a clean-room deterministic reference for Ada-KV's within-layer physical-head budget allocation and retained-mass bound without importing or executing upstream code.

sources.use: Algorithm 1 and Theorems 3.1/3.2 define global retained-weight allocation and the attention-output L1 upper bound
requires clean-room implementation because upstream environment and behavior are unqualified

input_contract.salience: rectangular H-by-T finite non-negative physical-cache-head weights
input_contract.normalization: each physical head sums to one for the paper-bound calculation; allocation itself also accepts unnormalized non-negative salience
input_contract.scope: one layer; cross-layer allocation is explicitly outside Ada-KV v5 and this protocol
input_contract.gqa: query-head to physical-KV-head reduction is outside the core theorem and must be frozen as a separate mean/max/other intervention

allocation.ordering: sort every (weight,head,token) by descending weight, then ascending head index, then ascending token index
allocation.selection: retain the first B entries globally
allocation.head_budget: B_h is the number of globally retained entries belonging to physical cache head h
allocation.per_head_identity: the globally retained entries for head h must equal that head's first B_h entries under the same within-head ordering
allocation.conservation: sum_h B_h equals B and every B_h lies in [0,T]

objectives.retained_mass: sum of the top B_h salience weights within every head
objectives.optimality: among every feasible integer head-budget vector with sum B, adaptive allocation maximizes retained mass
objectives.uniform_control: divide B by H; give the remainder one extra slot to lowest-index heads without exceeding T
objectives.eviction_bound: epsilon=2*H*C-2*C*retained_mass for normalized per-head attention and non-negative maximum transformed-value norm C
objectives.bound_monotonicity: epsilon cannot increase when B increases

qualification_cases.integer_weight_values: 0 through 7 with deterministic ties, normalized per head after replacing an all-zero head with one unit at token zero
qualification_cases.budgets: every integer from zero through H*T
qualification_cases.oracle: enumerate every feasible H-vector in [0,T]^H with sum B
adversarial: one token per head tied globally

required_outputs: case counts and maximum optimality gap

decision.success: all conservation, identity, exhaustive optimality, uniform dominance, deterministic tie, and bound-monotonicity checks pass exactly
decision.failure: retain the result and block use as an N2 baseline
